[SWS_DM_00333] Stopping of an
UDS
Transport Protocol implementation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
The DM shall call the
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProto-
colHandler::Stop
method of each UDS Transport Protocol implementation it has
started, if it is switching to state
ApplicationState.kTerminating
.
⌋
